source: Scope. This handbook establishes the memory mental model needed by the rest of Understanding AI Systems. Arithmetic intensity, Roofline analysis, detailed coalescing rules, shared-memory bank conflicts, register/occupancy tuning, kernel fusion, and profiling each receive dedicated handbooks later. Here they appear only far enough to make memory behavior coherent.
zh: 范围。本手册建立了理解人工智能系统其余部分所需的记忆心理模型。算术强度、Roofline 分析、详细的合并规则、共享内存库冲突、寄存器/占用调整、内核融合和分析稍后都会收到专门的手册。在这里，它们出现的距离仅足以使记忆行为变得连贯。
